replies.author: KooDaLord
replies.body:
Ooooo manguz... how I see you in the grassy dews,
You are everywhere even in the scorch hot dunes,
Ooooo manguz, you are a symbol of peace,
That makes me want to wear a pink fleece,
Ooooo manguz, if I were to pick 2,
I would pick some random dud and you,
When we meet again in the sunset,
I will give you flowers and you won't be upset.

- KooDaLord
